blank.title: Blank
blank.blurb: A manual trigger and one task step. The smallest recipe that runs.

error_guard.title: Error guard
error_guard.blurb: Every 15 minutes it reads one environment's error rate and opens a ticket per incident; the second time it comments on the first ticket. Pick the environment with the picker before saving.

spec.name: error guard
spec.description: watch prod error rate and open an incident ticket when it spikes
spec.env_comment: The environment's ID, not its name. Pick it with the Environment picker above the editor.
spec.env_comment_save: Save refuses an ID that does not exist.
spec.task_body: The 15-minute average error rate is {{ steps.errs.value }}%.
spec.task_body_ask: Investigate, and open a PR if it needs a code change.

pr_sweep.title: PR review sweep
pr_sweep.blurb: Hourly: find tasks with an open PR that nobody has touched in a day, and ask their agent to address the reviews.

spec.name: pr review sweep
spec.description: nudge the agent on PRs that have been sitting
spec.agent_comment: No agent: the mention wakes the one on the task's current stage.
spec.body: Your PR has had no activity for a day.
spec.body_ask: Check it for reviews or comments to address, and reply here with what you changed.

review_comments.title: Answer review comments
review_comments.blurb: When GitHub delivers a review comment on a PR that belongs to a task, mention the agent on that task — unless a bot wrote it.

spec.name: answer review comments
spec.description: a human review comment wakes the agent that owns the PR
spec.debounce_comment: The debounce gathers a burst into one run; the comments are all in trigger.payload.events.
spec.body: New review comment on {{ trigger.payload.pr_url }} from {{ trigger.payload.comment_by }}:

script_decides.title: Script decides
script_decides.blurb: Run a script in a sandbox every morning; only when its output says so does a model get involved.

spec.name: script decides
spec.description: cheap deterministic check first, model second
spec.script_comment: Anything that prints is available as steps.check.stdout.
spec.fingerprint_comment: One card per day. The date comes from the firing, so a run that starts at 23:59 does not land on tomorrow's card.
